profile.name: Lucian Horvat
profile.remotePreference: Open to remote and international work

projects.name: Interactive Portfolio Chat Platform
projects.summary: Built a conversational portfolio website that demonstrates technical depth through interactive recruiter-focused dialogue.
projects.problem: Static portfolios fail to communicate decision-making quality, architecture maturity, and business-aware engineering thinking.
projects.solution: Implemented a Next.js and TypeScript application with AI-assisted responses, structured UX flows, and responsive interaction patterns.

qualitative: Improved ability to communicate technical reasoning in recruiter conversations.
Created a reusable foundation for demonstrating architecture and product decisions.

architecture.pattern: Client-driven UI with server API orchestration
keyDecisions: Separated prompt/persona control in API route from UI behavior.
Used deterministic UI state control for chat, transcription, and dictation modes.
Added context-oriented prompt layers for recruiter-facing positioning.

responsibilities: AI integration and response quality tuning.
Interaction design across desktop and mobile.
tradeoffs: Prioritized maintainability and deterministic behavior over quick one-off UI shortcuts.
Balanced rich interaction features with stable state transitions.
challenges: Synchronizing speech, typewriter output, and interruption handling.
Keeping prompt strategy consistent while preventing fabricated claims.
Managing complex UI states without regressions.
whatYouLearned: How to combine product storytelling with technical architecture in one interface.
How to structure AI context layers for consistency and recruiter relevance.
How to harden real-time interaction flows with predictable state models.

capabilities: Designing scalable frontend architecture in Next.js and React.
Type-safe implementation with pragmatic TypeScript patterns.
Performance-aware UI decisions and responsive UX execution.
Translating product requirements into maintainable technical structures.
Owning full feature lifecycle from concept to production-ready behavior.
